data.title: About GUNICSH & Ganpat University
body: Ganpat University is a well-reputed State Private University located in Kherva, Mehsana in the state of Gujarat, India. It was established in 2005 through the State Legislative Act No. 19 of 2005. The University offers diverse multidisciplinary undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs across management, engineering, social sciences, and humanities.

The Ganpat University International Conference on Social Sciences & Humanities (GUNICSH) is organized annually by the Faculty of Social Sciences & Humanities (GUNIFSSH). It provides a high-impact global platform for academicians, educators, industry experts, doctoral scholars, and practitioners to exchange pioneering research findings, critical perspectives, and innovative ideas.

The 4th International Conference focuses on Human Technological Interaction (HTI), education transformation under the National Education Policy (NEP 2020), and contemporary global challenges, encouraging collaborative discourse across disciplines.

data.title: The GUNICSH Journey & Heritage
body: Ganpat University is a well-reputed State Private University in Kherva, Mehsana in the state of Gujarat, India. Established in 2005 through the State Legislative Act No. 19 of 2005, the university has continuously set benchmarks in multidisciplinary higher education, industry-aligned research, and holistic student development.

The Ganpat University International Conference on Social Sciences & Humanities (GUNICSH) was initiated with the objective of providing a vibrant platform for academicians, doctoral students, practitioners, and researchers. It enables the exchange of knowledge, empirical insights, and conceptual frameworks on the emerging roles of social sciences, business, and technology in the global economy.

From its 1st National Conference in 2018 to the upcoming 4th International Conference on Human Technological Interaction (HTI), GUNICSH has grown into a premier academic forum welcoming hundreds of national and international delegates each year.

data.title: Conference Theme & Setting
body: V. M. Patel College of Management Studies (VMPCMS) at Ganpat University, Gujarat, hosts the annual Ganpat University International Conference on Social Sciences & Humanities (GUNICSH).

The conference series provides a comprehensive academic stage where researchers present conceptual and empirical research papers, practitioner case studies, and scholarly reviews. Special plenary sessions and interactive tracks offer delegates rich opportunities for discussion and publication.

Participants can submit research papers across multiple tracks, compete for the prestigious Best Paper Award with a cash prize of ₹5,100 per track, and publish in Scopus-indexed and UGC-CARE listed journals.

data.title: Central Theme: Human Technological Interaction (HTI)
body: The central theme of GUNI FSSH's 4th International Conference is Human Technological Interaction (HTI). In an era defined by rapid advances in artificial intelligence, digital ecosystems, and ubiquitous computing, understanding the human, cultural, and ethical dimensions of technology has become paramount.

HTI represents a field in need of significant innovation and breakthroughs toward radically new future forms of interaction. The conference encourages participation across this thematic area as an open forum for scholars, technologists, behavioral scientists, and educational reformers.
We invite research contributions examining how emerging technologies interact with society, learning, business models, governance, and mental well-being.

data.title: Invitation for Submissions
body: Original ideas on the conference themes in the form of full academic/practitioner research papers, case studies, extended abstracts of work-in-progress, and proposals for poster presentations or film-based presentations are cordially invited.

All submissions undergo a rigorous double-blind peer review process evaluated by eminent subject matter experts. Accepted papers will be published in the conference proceedings with ISBN and considered for Scopus-indexed and UGC-CARE listed partner journals.
The authors of the best papers in each track will be awarded a cash prize of ₹5,100 along with an official Certificate of Merit.
